name: triggers
meaning: compacted CINnn triggers (0x20 bytes each), only those with ACTBOX != 0 and a resolvable ACTBOX list. +0x220..+0x23f is never touched (room for a 16th slot)

name: saveRequested
meaning: set once when a flag-0x8000 trigger fires (autosave or save UI requested). While set, the scan waits for MCardManager msg 2 == 0x21. Never cleared (Reset is ScnObject_Nop)
